premises.text: Good cafe-quality coffee is hard at home; single-serve pods waste, cost a lot, and use stale grounds, while home makers lack third-wave quality innovation
premises.evidence_span: it's kind of hard to make a good quality coffee at home

premises.text: Spin uses patented centrifugal brewing that controls barista-like brew elements without pods or filters, grinding fresh beans and spinning out dry residue
premises.evidence_span: uses patented centrifugal force technology to brew your coffee

premises.text: A connected app is remote control plus marketplace for local roasters, with sensor-triggered auto-replenishment of a bean playlist/queue
premises.evidence_span: The app is both a remote control for our machine and an online marketplace for local coffee roasters

premises.text: Business model takes margins on machines and a cut of marketplace bean orders
premises.evidence_span: we're going to make margins on the machines and the beans

domains.name: home coffee quality and pod waste

value.text: Third-wave coffee quality at home with single-serve convenience and no coffee downtime
value.evidence_span: combines the quality of the third wave coffee roasters with the convenience of a single serve pod system

causal_links.evidence_span: That wave is not sustainable. It creates a lot of waste
solve the biggest problem in coffee history, coffee downtime
Internet of Things meets coffee marketplace
